stages.name: 內容發布與落地
stages.preconditions: 合法發佈版本及原更新通道
stages.limits: HTTP/gzip/ordinary-file stage; not new game TCP blob

stages.name: 資源可見性與索引
stages.limits: Disk presence does not prove selected resource; no general hot-reload guarantee

stages.name: 0047雙鍵與Q接納
stages.preconditions: 合法signed-WORD quest/scene、field context、非busy正常路徑
stages.limits: Busy does not queue; mode can change before rejection; skip may report without entry

stages.name: 獨立VM同步依賴宣告
stages.limits: Failure may leave partial collector; return is not dependency success

stages.name: 模型與動作依賴工作
stages.preconditions: WORD keys、first model與正式行為對應
stages.limits: Native events/waits do not acknowledge all resource or gameplay success

stages.name: 正式seq與唯一outer登記
stages.preconditions: R9 lexical phase、原binding、正常Register、無重入
stages.limits: Two VMs have separate locals/globals; new outer is content design

stages.name: 載入模組與當次export
stages.preconditions: global DoFile numeric0；有限無yield頂層；驗當次export/version/entry
stages.limits: Not a native MapList caller; no module-return table; old export may persist

stages.name: 建立並逐次resume inner
stages.preconditions: 唯一outer、有效child、原coroutine binding、容量足夠、shared context合法
stages.limits: Only outer registered; no resume payload from MoCo; not a sandbox or preemptive watchdog

stages.name: 執行有限entry
stages.owner: Inner coroutine and selected native APIs
stages.limits: Ordinary escaped Lua errors covered; outer/API capacity/native faults not universal catch

stages.name: inner暫停後outer讓出
stages.limits: Yield payload not dt or sleep; no fixed frame interval guarantee

stages.name: 演出狀態觀察
stages.owner: Q actors / Prolog / Book / image owners
stages.preconditions: 有效typed owner與資源、native frame／UI條件
stages.limits: Prolog0 may fail/cancel; Book FB72AC gate; image no public per-image done query; not world death/group

stages.name: 按持有紀錄清理
stages.preconditions: 本run持有且未被外部覆寫；valid snapshot；balancedcamera；型別化image取消
stages.limits: Stop only active; map not stack; pop destructive; pending effects and errors retained

stages.name: 必要條件成立後最後End
stages.preconditions: normal non-review與合法owner；選定policy確認必要cleanup後置條件
stages.limits: End not bulk cleanup; no universal 003F; immediate outer return after End

stages.name: 原003F回報
stages.limits: 8-byte app; keys low16 + WORD1; skip also reports; not success/cleanup ACK

stages.name: 適用00EB等待解除
stages.limits: EB00 clears wait/mask0x2, not Q active/list/controller+58

stages.name: Server權威對帳與下一次run
stages.preconditions: 現有wire與本端權威狀態；合法結果、持久化、排他性
stages.limits: New local payload/generation is not an existing wire field; no reward from 003F alone

stages.name: 外部失敗／取消策略
stages.owner: Existing native lifecycle owner + Server policy
stages.preconditions: 選定實際可用的合法取消路由，保存未完成與unknown
stages.limits: No invented cancel setter; missing route remains integration dependency; outer return may leave active Q
